# Huruy Kidanemariam, Senior UX Designer & Builder

> Portfolio of Huruy Kidanemariam, a Senior UX Designer and Builder in Los Angeles crafting accessible, human-centered products for enterprise SaaS, compliance, AI, and social impact, with 8+ years of experience.

## Pages

- [Home](https://huruy.tech/): Featured UX case studies, skills, and overview.

- [Resume](https://huruy.tech/resume): Work history and downloadable resume.

## Case Studies

- [EBT Finder](https://huruy.tech/project/ebtfinder): Review-first store locator for SNAP/EBT households, researched, designed, built, and shipped solo to the App Store.
- [OneAsure Portal](https://huruy.tech/project/oneasure-portal): Unifying enterprise HR (time, benefits, payroll) into a single portal.
- [Beles](https://huruy.tech/project/beles): Culturally rooted dating and community app for the Tigrayan diaspora.
- [Asure Compliance Engine](https://huruy.tech/project/asure-compliance): Onsite redesign of an enterprise payroll compliance engine serving 9,000+ tax agencies. Full narrative available by request.
